description: Figure 8 displays four separate pie charts, each illustrating the distribution of refusal categories for a specific large language model (LM) on the FACTBENCH dataset. The models shown are GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. Each pie chart is segmented into colored portions representing different refusal reasons, with the exact category and its corresponding percentage labeled within each slice. For GPT4-o, the largest segment is “Lack of Knowledge” at 83.3% (red), followed by “Safety” at 16.7% (orange). For Gemini1.5-Pro, the largest segment is “Misinformation” at 38.4% (orange), followed by “Lack of Knowledge” at 22.1% (blue), “Safety” at 9.3% (red), “Ethical Advice” at 16.3% (light blue), and “Clarification” at 14.0% (yellow). For Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, the largest segment is “Lack of Knowledge” at 75.0% (orange), with “Clarification” at 25.0% (red). For Llama3.1-405B-Instruct, the chart is split equally between “Lack of Knowledge” at 50.0% (orange) and “Misinformation” at 50.0% (red). The charts are arranged in a two-by-two grid, with no legend provided, and the segments are not exploded or otherwise visually emphasized.
